home.seoDescription: Homemade pastries in Québec City: cakes, pastries and macarons handmade to order. Delivery in Québec City or pickup.
home.title: Handmade treats, made to order
home.lead: Cakes, pastries and macarons carefully prepared to order. You choose, and we call you to schedule the date.
home.step1Text: Choose your treats online. Your card is only authorized, not charged.
home.step2Text: Together, we set the date and time that suit you.
home.step3Text: We deliver in Québec City, or you can pick up your order.
home.seasonalLead: Seasonal creations, available for a limited time.
